description: Mirror the tampines rhoPimpleFoam fixes into outram-park-fork-coolprop OPCPFluidArray: (1) conservative energy ddt via continuity density rho_cont + ddt_coeff_old; (2) psi = drho/dp|_h finite-difference of the (p,h) flash; (3) opt-in SolverMode{Pimple,HybridAllMach} all-Mach KNP central-upwind hybrid with HEM equilibrium sound speed. CoolProp adaptation: HEM two-phase equilibrium sound speed via FD-of-(p,s) using vle.rs Maxwell construction; single-phase uses EOS speed_of_sound.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsiDesktop
notes.content: Done. Ported to OPCPFluidArray (crates/outram-park-fork-coolprop): (1) ddt_coeff_old added to fvm/ddt.rs + conservative energy ddt via rho_cont in step(); (2) psi=drho/dp|_h finite-difference of (p,h) flash in correct_thermo (was isothermal drho_dp_t); (3) opt-in SolverMode{Pimple(default),HybridAllMach} + new central_upwind.rs (KNP flux, beta(Ma), rho taper). HEM sound speed adaptation: single-phase uses EOS speed_of_sound (equilibrium==frozen there); two-phase uses a genuine FD-of-(p,s)-equilibrium a_HEM built on vle.rs Maxwell construction (phase_at_ph/saturation_*). Default mode bit-identical (hybrid no-op verified by test). 256 lib tests green. Caveat: rho taper consts 50/100 kg/m3 inherited from water front; neuters hybrid for low-density gas (documented). Two-phase correct_thermo still leaves stale props (unchanged, out of scope).

title: Port TampinesSteamArray solver fixes to OPCPFluidArray (coolprop)

description: Port GeN-Foam thermoMechanics: thermal-expansion / mesh-displacement feedback. Couples into pointKinetics coeffTStructMech + diffusion XS. After TH.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content: Ported the self-contained, analytically-verifiable core: ElasticMaterial constitutive model (material.rs), Hooke thermal-stress law + von Mises (stress.rs), axial fuel/CR expansion + meshDisp assembly feedback (feedback.rs), wired via LegacyThermoMechanics + ThermoMechanicsModel enum. 12 tests pass (11 unit + 1 doctest). Full FvMesh displacement/heat solve deferred to op-p6p.11 (needs basic-lib vector/tensor FV ops).

title: genfoam: thermoMechanics expansion feedback
